title: Neon Silhouette Dreamscape
description: A stylized black silhouette of a woman in profile faces right, her long flowing hair transforming into colorful swirling patterns and bubbles containing smaller silhouettes. A glowing neon purple duck with a butterfly on its head floats in front of her, all enclosed within a vibrant purple circular frame. The background features a gradient of purple to green with radiating lines, mountains, a small castle, pink flowers, and various floating orbs.
